# Priority 20 port source manifest
#
# Defines exactly which sources compile at each intermediate gate. Without this
# the phase 1 through 3 gates are unfalsifiable: "the build passes" means
# nothing if the build silently compiles less than you think.
#
# Select a stage with -PportStage=<name>. Default is "core".
# build.gradle reads this file. Do not edit one without the other.

[stage:core]
# Phase 1 and 2. Loader-neutral only. 85 main files, 5,391 lines, zero
# net.minecraft and zero net.fabricmc imports.
main.include = vectorregnum/core/**
# 15 of 47 test files. The other 32 reference vectorregnum.neoforge and return
# during the phase 3 vertical slices.
test.include = vectorregnum/core/automation/AutomationDataFrameTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/automation/AutomationRuleTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/automation/AutomationSchedulerTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/circle/CirclePersistenceTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/circle/MagicCircleAuthoringTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/circle/SpellArtifactTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/circle/Vm2CircleCompilerTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/CompatibilityFixturesTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/EngineHardeningTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/presentation/PresentationFoundationTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/semantic/SemanticFoundationTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/semantic/SemanticVmLowererTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/vm2/ManaCostModelTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/vm2/SpellVmTest.java
test.include = vectorregnum/core/vm2/StackTypeAnalyzerTest.java

# Deliberately excluded from stage:core even though it lives under core.
# vectorregnum/core/presentation/PresentationCompilerTest.java imports
# vectorregnum.neoforge.LibrarySemanticAdapter and
# vectorregnum.neoforge.progression.ProgressionSpellLibrary at lines 14-15.
# A core test depending on the loader package is a layering violation. Fix it
# during phase 3 rather than carrying it forward.
